title: Ten More Minutes
can_do: 问“还要多久”，听懂大人的时长解释，并把它变成可等待的时间。

conversation_move.label: ask how much longer and understand the answer

trigger: The family is on a car ride and Child wants to know how much longer until they arrive.
setting: Driving to the pool on a weekend morning.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: We're on our way to the pool.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: How long until we get there?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: About ten more minutes of driving.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Is ten minutes a long time?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: About as long as two songs.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Then let's sing the shark song twice!

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Good thinking. First songs, then swimming.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: After the pool, will we eat lunch? Because I'll be hungry!

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: We will, so swim hard and have fun.

replay_cards.title: Baking with Grandma
replay_cards.change: Child wants to know how long until they are ready.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks how long, understands 'ten minutes' as one cleanup of the table, and fills the wait by setting the plates.

replay_cards.title: Waiting at the clinic
replay_cards.setting: The waiting room before a check-up.
replay_cards.change: The receptionist says the doctor needs a few more minutes.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks Dad how long, understands the answer, and picks one book for the wait.

parent_support: 被问“还要多久”时给可感的参照：“两首歌那么长”，不用精确到分。
等孩子复述一遍你的答案，确认他真的理解了时长。
把等待变成他提议的小活动，而不是干等。
